Festival Promotion Campaign.name: Festival Promotion Campaign
Festival Promotion Campaign.questStatement: Principal Nezu has decided the School Festival will go ahead, and half the country thinks he is wrong. The police want guarantees, parents want reassurance, neighbors want no villains on their streets, and students outside the Hero Course want a festival worth having. The Management Course gets the job of selling it: the public message, the guest screening plan and a police briefing, all approved by Nezu.
Festival Promotion Campaign.mainObjective: Win public and police support for the School Festival with a campaign Principal Nezu approves.

completionCondition.query: The PC has built a School Festival campaign, briefed the police or the public on its security plan, and Principal Nezu has approved it.

Festival Promotion Campaign.questDesignBrief: Politics over tea. Principal Nezu tests every claim with a question; Naomasa Tsukauchi speaks for the police and wants guest lists; Present Mic and Midnight can front the publicity. Students in the other courses resent the Hero Course and the tighter rules; Class 1-A's planned stage show is a selling point if the PC can get Kyoka Jiro's group on board. Never promise the festival will be safe. Any child guest is private and stays out of the campaign. Failure: a weak plan lets Nezu shrink the festival to students only, and a public gaffe makes the news. Nothing here stages the festival day, a break-in attempt or the show.
